Problem Statement
Read an integer N and print the sum of the first N natural numbers using a while loop.
Description
Read an integer N from input. Use a while loop with a counter starting at 1 that adds the counter's value to a running sum on each iteration, and increases the counter by 1, continuing while the counter is less than or equal to N. Print the final sum after the loop ends.
Input Description
A single integer N (N >= 1).
Output Description
Print the sum of the numbers from 1 to N.
Sample Input
5
Sample Output
15
